content:
The last total solar eclipse before the year 2000 occurred on July 11, 1991.

This solar eclipse was visible from parts of Hawaii, Canada, Greenland, the North Atlantic Ocean, and northern Europe.

The previous total solar eclipse before that was on March 7, 1970. There were no other total solar eclipses between 1970 and 1991.

So in summary, the last total solar eclipse before the year 2000 was on July 11, 1991.
